spec_family.name: Exterior Window Prime and Paint
spec_family.description: EA-based spec with size bucket method (S/M/L). Three cladding types (wood/aluminum-clad/vinyl-clad) with cladding-driven primer selection. Window type (awning through bow) is primary production rate driver. Brush is primary application method. 1/16" glass lap for weather seal. Low-E glass liquid masking prohibited. Sash sequence module prevents double-hung blocking. Window casing belongs to SF_TRIM_EXT_NC_v1.

includes: Window sash painting (all operable and fixed types)
Muntin bar painting (TDL and SDL types)
Glass masking (tape-and-film or liquid mask per Low-E status and muntin type)
Hardware removal and reinstallation (locks, lifts, sash pulls, crank handles)
Cladding-driven surface preparation (wood sand/fill, aluminum scuff-sand/wash, vinyl clean)
Cladding-driven primer application (acrylic for wood, corrosion-inhibiting for aluminum, PVC bonding for vinyl, tannin spot for wood knots)
Two finish coats (standard or premium acrylic trim enamel, or VinylSafe IR-reflective for vinyl-clad LRV < 55)
Sash sequence for double-hung blocking prevention (reversal, dry posture, periodic movement, channel lubrication)
Glass cleanup — razor scrape excess paint beyond 1/16" glass lap line

excludes.item: Window casing prep, prime, and paint
Interior window surfaces (stool interior face, interior jamb)
Glass masking during whole-house spray operations (siding/trim context)

excludes.route_to: PROHIBITED — not valid for window components
EXCLUDED — exterior windows are visible architectural elements requiring minimum QT3

configuration_dimensions.description: Quality tier controlling pace, scrutiny level, intercoat sanding, and defect tolerance.
configuration_dimensions.notes: QT3=standard (production pace, 6-foot visual, no intercoat sand). QT4=premium (slower pace, raking light at 3 feet, intercoat sand 220-grit). QT5=supreme (meticulous pace, arm's length lighted inspection, hand-sand 220/320, DFT verification). QT2 excluded — exterior windows are visible architectural elements.

configuration_dimensions.description: Window cladding material — drives primer system, prep protocol, and topcoat restrictions.
configuration_dimensions.notes: Wood: acrylic primer, sand mill glaze, tannin spot prime knots. Aluminum-clad: corrosion-inhibiting primer, scuff-sand, TSP wash. Vinyl-clad: PVC bonding primer, clean only (no sanding), VinylSafe IR-reflective mandatory for LRV < 55. Per-project capture with per-window override possible.

configuration_dimensions.description: Window type classification — PRIMARY cost driver alongside size bucket.
configuration_dimensions.notes: Fixed is simplest (frame only, no sash hardware or blocking prevention). Double-hung is calibration baseline. Bay/bow are multi-sash assemblies. Double-hung triggers sash sequence module.

configuration_dimensions.description: Muntin/grille type — SECONDARY cost driver affecting masking and painting labor.
configuration_dimensions.notes: GBG (grilles between glass) has no painting impact. SDL (simulated divided lite) adds moderate time for applied bar painting. TDL (true divided lite) adds major time for individual pane masking + muntin bar painting. Liquid mask permitted for TDL on non-Low-E glass only.
No locked-in default. Windows follow trim-class sheen. Higher sheen = more durable but reveals surface imperfections. Gloss requires higher prep quality.

Brush is PRIMARY — precision required for 1/16" glass lap, sash sequence, cutting in around glass. Spray is CONDITIONAL (whole-house spray context only — adds masking overhead). Roller is NOT valid. Spray savings limited (~25-30% faster) due to mandatory back-brushing on detailed profiles.

paintable_items.name: Exterior window — small (glass area < 6 SF)
paintable_items.counting_rules: Each small window assembly is 1 EA. Covers awning, casement, fixed window types that fall in the small size bucket. Frame, sash, muntins (if TDL/SDL) included.
paintable_items.notes: Size bucket S. Visual categorization during exterior walkthrough based on glass area < 6 SF.

paintable_items.name: Exterior window — medium (glass area 6-15 SF)
paintable_items.counting_rules: Each medium window assembly is 1 EA. Most common size bucket for standard double-hung and casement windows. Calibration baseline for production rates.
paintable_items.notes: Size bucket M. Glass area 6-15 SF.

paintable_items.name: Exterior window — large (glass area > 15 SF)
paintable_items.counting_rules: Each large window assembly is 1 EA. Bay and bow windows are always forced into L bucket regardless of glass area. Bay/bow counted as 1 EA each despite multi-sash geometry — window_type modifier drives the elevated per-EA rate.
paintable_items.notes: Size bucket L. Glass area > 15 SF. Includes bay/bow windows.

variants.notes: Common baseline: standard brush on medium double-hung wood window. Full prime+2finish round. Sash sequence module active.
Premium brush on double-hung TDL wood window. High masking labor. Intercoat sand 220-grit. Muntin detail work.
Standard brush on aluminum-clad casement. Corrosion-inhibiting primer mandatory even over factory finish.
Standard brush on vinyl-clad fixed window. PVC bonding primer mandatory. No hardware removal (fixed). No weatherstrip protection (fixed). Simplest configuration.
Supreme spray on bay window. Near maximum scope. Bay (2.00x) + QT5 inspection/sanding + spray masking overhead. Siding masking required for spray.
Standard brush on factory-primed wood window. Skip prime module — factory primer is adequate base for wood. Two finish coats only.
Standard brush on factory-primed aluminum-clad. STILL requires field prime (corrosion-inhibiting) even over factory finish. Full 3-coat round.
Standard brush on field-primed window (any cladding). Skip prime module entirely. Two finish coats.

required_paintscope_inputs.required_when: When project has small exterior windows (glass area < 6 SF)
required_paintscope_inputs.description: Count of small exterior windows to paint.

required_paintscope_inputs.required_when: When project has medium exterior windows (glass area 6-15 SF)
required_paintscope_inputs.description: Count of medium exterior windows to paint. Calibration baseline for production rates.

required_paintscope_inputs.required_when: When project has large exterior windows (glass area > 15 SF) or bay/bow windows
required_paintscope_inputs.description: Count of large exterior windows to paint. Bay/bow always forced into L bucket.
Count of windows requiring glass masking. Typically 1:1 with total window count. Masking time varies by muntin_type.
Window type classification — PRIMARY production rate driver. Values: awning, casement, double_hung, fixed, bay, bow.
Window cladding material — drives primer system, prep protocol, and topcoat restrictions. Values: wood, aluminum_clad, vinyl_clad.
Muntin/grille type — affects masking labor and painting time. Values: none, gbg, sdl, tdl.
Low-E glass status. HARD STOP: Low-E = true prohibits liquid masking (scoring damages Low-E coating permanently).
Boolean flag confirming new construction context. Always true for this NC spec.
Access type per elevation. HEIGHT IS A MAJOR MODIFIER for windows. Ground=1.00, ladder=1.35, scaffold=1.60.

valid_input_states.notes: Three NC-relevant substrate states. SS_EXT_BARE_WOOD is dominant for wood windows. SS_EXT_PRIMED_FACTORY is dominant for aluminum-clad and vinyl-clad. SS_EXT_BARE_METAL is NOT applicable — window cladding is never bare metal. SS_EXT_PRIMED_FIELD for split-mobilization scenarios.

output_state.notes: Output state varies by sheen selection.

SS_EXT_BARE_WOOD.notes: Acrylic exterior primer for bare wood. Tannin spot-prime knots with SYS_EXT_WIN_PRIMER_TANNIN_SPOT before full coat on tannin-rich species (cedar, redwood, fir). Seal all end-grain on sash edges.

wood.notes: Factory-primed wood skips field prime. Direct to 2 finish coats.

aluminum_clad.notes: Aluminum-clad STILL requires field prime (corrosion-inhibiting) even over factory finish. Mandatory for adhesion.

vinyl_clad.notes: Vinyl-clad STILL requires field prime (PVC bonding) even over factory finish. Standard primers will NOT bond to vinyl. Recoat within 1 week.

SS_EXT_PRIMED_FIELD.notes: Field-primed surfaces skip prime module entirely. Direct to 2 finish coats.

material_systems.name: 100% Acrylic Latex Exterior Primer for Wood Windows
material_systems.notes: Standard exterior acrylic primer for bare wood window frames, sashes, and muntins. Seal all end-grain on sash edges. For tannin-rich species, supplement with alkyd spot-prime at knots BEFORE this full coat.

material_systems.name: Alkyd/Shellac Spot Primer for Tannin Knots on Wood Windows
material_systems.notes: Spot-applied to visible knots on tannin-rich species (cedar, redwood, fir). Not a full-surface system. Applied by brush to individual knots before full acrylic primer coat.

material_systems.name: Corrosion-Inhibiting Primer for Aluminum-Clad Windows
material_systems.notes: Industrial-grade corrosion-inhibiting primer (e.g., SW Pro-Cryl). MANDATORY even over factory finish. Must be applied over mechanical bonding profile (180-220 grit scuff-sand).

material_systems.name: PVC Bonding Primer for Vinyl-Clad Windows
material_systems.notes: Specialized PVC bonding primer (e.g., INSL-X STIX). MANDATORY for vinyl-clad even over factory finish. Recoat within 1 week or primer loses flexibility and becomes brittle. Standard primers will NOT bond to vinyl.

material_systems.name: Standard Exterior Acrylic Trim Enamel for Windows
material_systems.notes: Mid-grade 100% acrylic exterior trim enamel. Hard enamel for UV resistance. Flexible for thermal expansion. Replaced by SYS_EXT_WIN_FINISH_VINYLSAFE when vinyl-clad and LRV < 55.

material_systems.name: Premium Urethane-Modified Acrylic Trim Enamel for Windows
material_systems.notes: Premium exterior trim enamel (SW Emerald Urethane Trim Enamel, BM Aura). QT5: self-leveling for brush-mark-free finish on detailed muntin work. Maximum hardness, gloss retention, UV resistance.

material_systems.name: VinylSafe IR-Reflective Exterior Enamel for Vinyl-Clad Windows
material_systems.notes: MANDATORY for vinyl-clad windows when color LRV < 55. IR-reflective Complex Inorganic Color Pigments (CICPs) drop surface temperature 20-30 deg F. SW VinylSafe Color Technology palette. Without VinylSafe: standard paint LRV must be 55+ to avoid vinyl warping/buckling.

modules.name: Exterior Window Protection Teardown & Equipment Clean

production_summary.rate_basis: EA (each window assembly) — fixed_time_minutes per EA with size bucket variants (S/M/L)

time_estimates_by_scenario.scenario: Medium casement, wood, bare, brush, QT3 — common baseline
time_estimates_by_scenario.notes: Standard NC window. Includes setup/mask, wood prep, prime, 2 finish coats, intercoat inspection, glass cleanup, teardown.

time_estimates_by_scenario.scenario: Medium double-hung, wood, bare, brush, QT4 — common premium
time_estimates_by_scenario.notes: Adds sash sequence module (4 tasks), intercoat sanding, higher-quality inspection.

time_estimates_by_scenario.scenario: Large bay, aluminum-clad, spray, QT5 — near maximum scope
time_estimates_by_scenario.notes: Bay (2.00x) + QT5 + aluminum-clad prep + spray masking overhead. Flagged for field validation.

production_summary.worst_case_stack: Bow (2.50) x TDL (1.75) x aluminum_clad (1.15) x scaffold (1.60) x QT5 (1.30) x poor (1.35) x moderate_wind (1.10) x full_sun (1.15) x hot (1.10) = 19.66x, capped to 4.0x
production_summary.common_high_scenario: Double-hung (1.00) x TDL (1.75) x wood (1.00) x ladder (1.35) x QT5 (1.30) = 3.07x (within cap)
production_summary.common_low_scenario: Casement (0.85) x none (1.00) x wood (1.00) x ground (1.00) x QT3 (1.00) = 0.85x (below baseline)

protection_zones_required.notes: Glass pane masking. Method varies: HDPE static-cling film for standard single-lite/SDL/GBG. Liquid mask for TDL non-Low-E. Tape-and-film per pane for TDL Low-E (highest labor). Low-E liquid masking PROHIBITED.
Window hardware (locks, lifts, sash pulls, crank handles) is REMOVED — not masked. Labeled bags per window. Reinstall after final coat dry. Fixed windows have no operable hardware — skip.
Weatherstripping on operable sashes. NEVER PAINT weatherstripping — destroys elasticity. Remove friction-fit or deep-tape non-removable. Fixed windows: skip.
Tape and paper/film over finished exterior sill. Conditional on sill being already painted. Reusing existing sill_protection zone.
Light tape at casing-to-frame junction when casing is already finished. Only at junction line — minimal masking.
Protect finished siding around window perimeter. Upgrades to full_mask (paper and tape) for spray application. Minimal concern for brush work.

adjacent_surfaces.notes: Window casing frames the window opening. SF_TRIM_EXT_NC_v1 scope. May be same or different color/sheen.
Glass-to-frame edge is the 1/16" glass lap line. MANDATORY weather seal — paint intentionally overlaps onto glass.
Exterior sill — may be shared scope with SF_TRIM_EXT_NC_v1. This spec covers sill painting when accessible during window work.
Siding-to-window junction: casing typically intervenes. No direct adjacency deduplication needed.
Interior window surfaces belong to SF_WINDOW_INT_NC_v1. Scope boundary at window frame-to-jamb junction.

site_condition_rules.notes: HEIGHT IS A MAJOR MODIFIER for windows. Windows are frequently on upper stories unlike doors (ground level). Applied to all per-window tasks.
High wind blocks spray operations entirely — brush fallback. Moderate wind adds 10% overhead. Brush operations unaffected.

site_condition_rules.affected_tasks: All finish and prime coat application tasks
site_condition_rules.notes: Full sun on south/west elevation = 15% time increase. Per doctrine: 'follow the sun' — paint in shade to prevent temperature blisters.

site_condition_rules.affected_tasks: All prime and finish coat application tasks
site_condition_rules.notes: Cold/hot extend recoat intervals (+10% time). Extreme temperatures (below 40F or above 95F surface temp) block application entirely.

adjacent_specs.relationship: Window casing painting belongs to trim spec. Glass masking ownership: window spec masks glass when painting the WINDOW; trim spec masks glass adjacent to CASING. Exterior sill may be shared scope.
Interior window surfaces (stool interior face, interior jamb) belong to interior window spec. Scope boundary at window frame-to-jamb junction.

cross_spec_boundaries.cross_spec_protection_note: Glass masking during whole-house spray operations (siding/trim context) is the SIDING or TRIM spec's protection responsibility, not this spec's.
deduplication_notes: Window CASING painting belongs to SF_TRIM_EXT_NC_v1 — this spec covers the window unit itself: frame, sash, muntin bars, jamb extension, stool, apron.
Glass masking ownership: when painting the WINDOW, this spec masks glass. When painting the CASING, the trim spec protects adjacent glass via its own zone.
Interior window surfaces (stool interior face, interior jamb) belong to SF_WINDOW_INT_NC_v1. Scope boundary at window frame-to-jamb junction.
Window glass masking during whole-house spray operations is the SIDING or TRIM spec's protection responsibility.
Exterior sill may be shared scope with SF_TRIM_EXT_NC_v1. This spec covers sill painting when accessible during window work.

round_configurations.description: 1 prime coat + 2 finish coats — standard NC for bare wood and aluminum/vinyl clad (mandatory field prime)
round_configurations.notes: SS_EXT_PRIMED_FACTORY on aluminum/vinyl clad STILL requires field prime (adhesion promotion). Only SS_EXT_PRIMED_FACTORY on WOOD uses ROUND_XWIN_PRIME_2FINISH_WOOD_FACTORY instead.

round_configurations.description: 2 finish coats only — field-primed any cladding type
Factory-primed wood — skip field prime, direct to 2 finish coats
round_configurations.notes: Wood factory primer is adequate base for topcoat (unlike aluminum/vinyl clad which always need field prime).

sequencing_notes.production_sequence: Setup -> Prep -> Prime (conditional) -> Finish 1 -> Interstage -> Finish 2 -> Sash Sequence (double-hung only) -> Final Inspect -> Cleanup
sequencing_notes.protection_sequence: Glass masking -> Hardware removal -> Weatherstrip protection -> Sill protection -> Casing protection -> Siding masking (spray) -> Equipment setup -> Coating work -> Glass cleanup -> Masking removal -> Hardware reinstall -> Weatherstrip reinstall -> Sill/casing teardown -> Siding mask removal -> Equipment clean
sequencing_notes.coat_sequence: Prep (cladding-driven) -> Prime (1 coat, conditional on substrate state and cladding) -> Finish coat 1 -> Interstage (inspect, sand QT4/QT5, repair, dust) -> Finish coat 2 -> Sash sequence (double-hung) -> Final inspect -> Touch up -> Glass cleanup
sequencing_notes.brush_stroke_sequence: Horizontal rails first, then vertical stiles (with the grain). Muntins (TDL/SDL): 1.5-inch angular sash brush, each bar face and edges, glass lap at each junction.
sequencing_notes.key_prohibitions: NO roller application. NO liquid mask on Low-E glass. NO painting of sliding channels (pulley stiles). NO painting of weatherstripping. NEVER fully close double-hung sashes during drying.

relationships.notes: First exterior window spec. Adjacent to trim spec (casing). Interior counterpart: SF_WINDOW_INT_NC_v1. Key departures from interior: 3 cladding types (vs wood/aluminum/steel), corrosion-inhibiting and PVC bonding primers, VinylSafe IR-reflective, height as MAJOR modifier, weather seal glass lap, environmental condition modifiers, Low-E liquid masking prohibition.

change_log.author: SpecFactory
change_log.changes: Initial draft spec for exterior window prime and paint. First exterior window spec — EA-based with 3 size buckets (S/M/L) and 3 paintable items (ITM_WINDOW_EXT_S/M/L). 3 cladding types (wood/aluminum-clad/vinyl-clad) with distinct primer paths. 6 window types (awning/casement/double_hung/fixed/bay/bow) as primary cost driver. 4 muntin types (none/gbg/sdl/tdl) as secondary cost driver. 51 tasks across 9 modules (28 binary, 21 qt_scaled, 2 qt_conditional). 7 material systems (4 primers + 2 finishes + 1 VinylSafe IR-reflective specialty). 6 protection zones. 9 factor modifiers. 3 round configurations. Context prefix XWIN. Key features: brush primary application, 1/16" glass lap weather seal, Low-E liquid masking HARD STOP, sash sequence module for double-hung blocking prevention, cladding-driven primer selection, VinylSafe IR-reflective for vinyl-clad dark colors, height as MAJOR modifier. QA result: pass (3 minor issues, 0 blockers).
